description.zh: 侧栏导航新增「置顶/未读」入口（带数量角标）：点一下就在图标下方贴左侧栏展开浮层，置顶会话排前、后台跑完未读的排后；点会话立即切换且浮层不收起，行尾可取消置顶，底部可进入完整页面。
description.en: Adds a Pinned/Unread entry with a count badge to the sidebar navigation: one click expands a floating list inside the left column, pinned sessions first, then sessions that finished in the background and are still unread. Stories switch in one click without closing the list, rows can be unpinned, and a full page is one footer click away.
